{{Attr|Bloated}} (Wave 15 only) }} ==Description== The '''Eclipsed''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]]. It can currently only be accessed through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It had a high amount of health, high defense and walked at an average pace. It had [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Stun Immunity]], making it harder to slow down, the [[Splash Damage Immunity]], making it immune to [[Splash Damage]], and it had [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]] making it leave a [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] on death. ==Appearance== The '''Eclipsed''' has brown skin and one, large yellow glowing eye on its head. It wears a grey chestplate and shoulder-pads, and brown belt. It has multiple yellow glowing eyes on its torso. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Nil Zone]] is listed instead. *Towers like [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] and [[Minigunner]] are recommended to be used for their high DPS. *As the '''Eclipsed''' has the [[Splash Damage Immunity]], towers like [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] are completely useless as they are unable to deal damage to it. *Due to its immunities, freezing towers like the [[Freezer]] and knockback towers like the [[Brawler]] are unable to stall it, while stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] only slow it down instead of stunning it completely. *Due to its high defense, towers like [[Pyromancer]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be incredibly useful at depleting it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} EclipsedWalk.gif|Walking animation (4 October 2025 – Present) EclipsedStun.gif|Stun animation (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseEclipsed.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} EclipsedIconIG.png|'''Eclipsed''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''4 October 2025''' - [[v1.76.0|v1.76.2b]] **'''Eclipsed''' added. *'''4 October 2025''' - [[v1.76.0|v1.76.2d]] **'''Eclipsed''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''11 October 2025''' - [[v1.76.0|v1.76.4a]] **'''Eclipsed''' re-added to the main game in the [[Nil Zone]]. **Health decreased from 3,000 to 2,500 in [[Nil Zone]]. *'''12 October 2025''' - [[v1.76.0|v1.76.4b]] **'''Eclipsed''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{AdminAbuseLiveEvent|[[Hidden Boss]]|Wave 10|Eclipsed|Wave 11|[[Breaker4]] & [[Executioner (Pizza Party)|Executioner]]|Wave 12}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Eclipsed}}
